items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-09
items.q: Interviewer mentions sending the interview to Barry Martin and apologizes that Barry didn't get to talk to you.

ctx.x: I'll make a note on here that this is Bill Russell interviewing Mr. Abby Foster, Chai Nee, the famous drummer. How you start off. Interviewing him for Barry Martin. We'll send this to Barry. I'm sorry Barry didn't get to talk to you. But I'll try to ask you a few questions about your life and drumming. Do you want to start off giving your full name?
